title: Carbon nanotube (single-wall) — carbon materials
description: The carbon nanotube (single-wall) is a carbon nanomaterial with tensile strength: ~100 GPa intrinsic; youngs modulus: ~1 TPa; dimensionality: 1D fiber/cylinder; best for: composite reinforcement and fibers. Fabrication route: arc discharge. The nanoscale runs 1–100 nm; a nanometer is a billionth of a meter — about 100,000 times smaller than a human hair’s width.
